topics: Introduction to Industrial Safety : Concept of Safety
definitions of Accident, injury, unsafe actions &Conditions
Responsibility of Safety - Society, Govt., Management, Union & employees
Hazard and hazard identification: Hazard and risk
Types of Chemical hazards and its control
Classification of Fire and Fire extinguishers
Electrical Hazards – controls- Safe limits of amperages
Means of cutting of power overload and short circuit protection
Hazard identification and risk assessment: Inventory analysis
Hazard rating of process plants- The Dow Fire and Explosion Hazard Index
Occupational Health and Safety : Safety and Health training
Ergonomics Hazards - Musculoskeletal Disorders and Cumulative Trauma Disorders
Personal protection in the work environment
Hearing Conservation Program in Production industries
Safety issues in Machines : Machinery safeguard
Principle of machine guarding -types of guards and devices
Safety in machining, welding and cutting
Material Handling-Classification-safety consideration- manual and mechanical handling-Maintenance of common elements-wire rope, chains slings, hooks, clamps
Monitoring Safety Performance: Frequency rate, severity rate, incidence rate Housekeeping, Work permits system

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Describe the theories of accident causation and preventive measures of industrial accidents.
Describe the different types of hazards and apply hazard identification tools.
Understand the occupational health hazards and human factors contributing to industrial accidents.
Explain about personal protective equipment, its selection, safety performance &indicators.
Describe various hazards associated with different machines and mechanical material handling.
